class.name: SamplingAddress
class.description: Defines sampling address for event monitoring

attribute.name: SamplerNames
attribute.description: Monitoring task will be connected to all samplers of the SamplerType type whose names are given in this list.

attribute.name: NumberOfSamplers
attribute.description: Alternative to providing a list of SamplerNames. If SamplerNames list is empty then the monitoring task will be connected to the given number of arbitrary chosen samplers of the SamplerType type.

class.name: SamplingParameters
class.description: Defines all necessary parameters for event monitoring

attribute.name: BufferSize
attribute.description: Size of the buffer to store events locally. It should be small (<10) if full event are sampled. In case of sampling from ROD or ROS it should be made bigger (e.g. 1000) to have the best sampling performance.

attribute.name: GroupName
attribute.description: Name of the monitoring group. Monitors with the same group name and selection criteria will never receive same events. This attribute replaces functionality of DispersalDistribution: if GroupName is non-empty, dispersion is set to true

class.name: SelectionCriteria
class.description: Defines selection criteria for event monitoring

attribute.name: L1TriggerType_Ignore
attribute.description: If the value is non zero then L1TriggerType value will not be used for event selection.

attribute.name: L1Bits
attribute.description: List of positions of non-zero bits in the L1 information. Interpretation of these bits depends on the value of the L1BitPattern_Logic parameter.

attribute.name: L1Bits_Logic
attribute.description: If the value is IGNORE then L1Bits value will not be used for event selection. Value AND means that all bits given by L1Bits have to be present in event header, OR requires at least one of them to be set in event header to get this event selected.

attribute.name: L1Bits_Origin
attribute.description: Defines which of the three L1 bit sets existed in an event header have to be matched.

attribute.name: StatusWord
attribute.description: Event header status word. Selection will succeed if at least one status word in event header is the same as this one.

attribute.name: StatusWord_Ignore
attribute.description: If the value is non zero then StatusWord will not be used for event selection.

attribute.name: StreamNames
attribute.description: List of event streams names. List can be empty in which case all events of the given StreamType will be selected.

attribute.name: Stream_Logic
attribute.description: Value IGNORE excludes StreamType and StreamNames from being used for selection. AND implies that selected events must belong to all given StreamNames, OR requires that event must belong at least to one given stream to be selected.
